# Project Instructions

These instructions apply to chat-based coding work in this repository.

- In frontend React code, always use the existing `useTranslation` hook for user-facing text instead of hardcoded strings.
- Use dedicated request validation classes for validation.
- Keep resources minimal and strict: only expose fields that are actually needed and used by the client.
- Do not ask for permission to read ordinary code files. Only ask before reading sensitive files such as secrets, environment files, credentials, keys, or other private data.
- Always use the existing code style and conventions of the project. Do not introduce new styles or patterns unless there is a compelling reason to do so.
- Always use the theme-accent instead of hardcoded colors in frontend code.
- Always try to use the existing components and utilities in the project instead of creating new ones, unless there is a compelling reason to do so.
- When suggesting code, only suggest the code that is necessary to implement the requested change. Do not suggest unrelated code or code that is not directly relevant to the change.
